The first time you speak with her:
:''"Impress me in battle, then we talk!"''
:'''Accept:''' ''"Bring it! (Fight.)"''
:'''Decline:''' ''"Maybe some other time."''

Subsequent dialogue:
:''"I hate the sound of Modniir hooves thundering through the air. It's so loud I swear they have four extra legs.
